title: Nil-Coalescing and Optional Transformation
learning_outcomes: Explain the purpose of nil-coalescing and optional transformation in a Swift program or workflow.
Apply the ?? operator in a small, inspectable example.
Check the expected result and identify one boundary case or platform constraint.

content.intro: This lesson focuses on nil-coalescing and optional transformation and the practical choices around it. Start with the smallest example, connect it to “The ?? operator”, and verify the result before adding complexity.
content.why_it_matters: Reusable functions and precise data models reduce duplication. Handling missing data and failures explicitly makes later application code safer to change.

content_blocks.title: Reasoning About Optionals
content_blocks.alt_text: The flow starts with an optional value, checks whether it exists, safely binds it and uses the resulting non-optional value.
content_blocks.caption: An optional is a value that may be present or absent.

content_blocks.text: **Start with the rule.** For the ?? operator, identify the contract, the valid inputs, and the failure or boundary case. Write the smallest reusable Swift example that makes those decisions visible.

**Work through the lesson.** Represent absence with optionals and operation failures with errors; choose the right recovery path. The detailed subtopic list in this lesson preserves the curriculum coverage; treat each item as a cue for a small example or a focused question rather than trying to memorize syntax.
